name: WayriCAD Embed3D
description: One component matrix: embed symbols, footprints and 3D models; unbundle, relink, or do both with checked selections.
description_full: One window with global and per-component Symbols, Footprints and 3D models checkboxes. Visible Embed checked, Embed all, Unbundle, Relink and Unbundle & relink actions share a preview/apply workflow. Archive actual bytes, preserve model transforms and native symbol caches, and create verified external library links. Select asset and new-design folders; choose relative/absolute paths, child sheets and conservative attachment removal. Main operations read saved files and create new design copies, not edits to open buffers. Previous standalone library, repair and live-model tools remain under Options. Approved icon included. Offline KiCad 10 SWIG addon, not IPC or KiCad 11. Testing release: native UI, installation, rendering and live integration remain unverified.
